title: [Peek] Preview the target of shortcut files

proposed_comments.title: Pass the shortcut command to the fallback previewer
proposed_comments.body:
### Pass the shortcut command to the fallback previewer

**Severity:** `high`

When a `.lnk` reaches the browser fallback, its binary content is rejected and `Previewer_PropertyChanged` replaces it with `CreateDefaultPreviewer(Item)`. Only the initial `OnItemPropertyChanged` path assigns this command, so the replacement keeps it null; `UpdateShortcutTarget` copies null into the card's command even when the target exists. This leaves an enabled **Open in Peek** link with no navigation command. Please also initialize the replacement's `PeekShortcutTargetCommand` before `UpdatePreviewAsync`, retaining the selected-shortcut-first behavior.

confidence.rationale: Fresh exact-head lifecycle trace confirms initial-only assignment, replacement default construction, null model command and command-only hyperlink binding. Binary shortcut header confirms the text-rejection stimulus; no UI reproduction claimed.
